q: Quality Gate fails on new code but the issues are in old files I didn't touch
a: SonarQube's New Code period may be misconfigured. Go to Project → Administration → New Code and set it to 'Previous version' or 'Reference branch'. Ensure `sonar.newCode.referenceBranch` is set in your scanner properties to the correct base branch (e.g., main).

q: Coverage shows 0% in SonarQube even though tests pass and generate a report
a: The scanner cannot find the coverage report. Set the correct path: `sonar.python.coverage.reportPaths=coverage.xml` or `sonar.coverage.jacoco.xmlReportPaths=target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml`. Run tests BEFORE the scanner. Verify the report file actually exists at the configured path.

The token is invalid or expired. Generate a new Project Analysis Token in SonarQube → My Account → Security. Pass it via `SONAR_TOKEN` env var (not `SONAR_LOGIN` which is deprecated). Ensure the token has 'Execute Analysis' permission on the project.

q: Scanner cannot connect to the SonarQube server
a: Check: 1) `SONAR_HOST_URL` is correct and reachable from the CI agent (curl test). 2) TLS certificate is trusted — add CA cert to the JVM truststore if using self-signed. 3) Firewall/proxy: set `sonar.scanner.proxyHost` and `sonar.scanner.proxyPort` if behind a proxy.

q: PR decoration (inline comments) is not appearing in my Git provider
a: Requires: 1) Developer Edition or higher. 2) ALM integration configured in SonarQube → Administration → ALM Integrations. 3) Pipeline sets `sonar.pullrequest.key`, `sonar.pullrequest.branch`, `sonar.pullrequest.base`. 4) The ALM token has permission to write comments on PRs.

q: SonarQube scanner is very slow or runs out of memory
a: Increase scanner heap: set env var `SONAR_SCANNER_OPTS=-Xmx2g`. For large projects, also set `sonar.scm.disabled=true` if SCM blame info is slow. Run scanner on a machine with at least 4GB RAM available. Exclude generated code with `sonar.exclusions`.
